population.span: randomized clinical trial among 360 consecutive candidates for cardiac surgery enrolled in 11 Italian centers between March 2012 and March 2014.

endpoint.span: main secondary study end points were postoperative AF and pericardial or pleural effusion.

estimate.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

ci.span: postoperative AF (colchicine, 61 patients [33.9%]; placebo, 75 patients [41.7%]; absolute difference, 7.8%; 95% CI, -2.2% to 17.6%)

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomized to receive placebo (n=180) or colchicine (0.5 mg twice daily in patients ≥70 kg or 0.5 mg once daily in patients <70 kg; n=180) starting between 48 and 72 hours before surgery and continued for 1 month after surgery.

follow_up.span: PROTOCOL PRIMARY OUTCOME: Post-pericardiotomy syndrome, post-operative effusions, post-operative atrial fibrillation incidence | Incidence of the outcomes at 3 months from cardiac surgery | TIME FRAME: 3 months

absent_reason: analysis_set: No held source explicitly identifies the analysis population for the 61 versus 75 postoperative AF events as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or all randomized.
served_mismatch: The served event counts agree with the abstract. However, the reported effect and CI are an absolute difference, not an RR. The served ITT designation is not explicitly supported. The served in-hospital/index-admission timepoint is not stated; the registry specifies 3 months, without explicitly linking that protocol timepoint to the abstract's estimate.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Registry eligibility specifies adults who are candidates for cardiac surgery, excluding transplantation; ITT describes an analysis set rather than entry eligibility.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Age \> 18years * Candidate to cardiac surgery but cardiac transplantation * Informed consent

notes: Registry spans are used for protocol follow-up and adult eligibility. The abstract does not explicitly state the estimate's follow-up window. Denominators are randomized arm sizes from the intervention span. The positive absolute difference is oriented placebo minus colchicine; its CI must not be used as an RR CI. No RR was calculated.
